'''Sylvester''' (Japanese: '''サンシロー''' ''Sanshirō'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[BW039|Reunion Battles In Nimbasa!]]''. He participated in the [[Club Battle]] tournament, but lost in a {{pkmn|battle}} against [[Georgia]], thus getting knocked out in the very first round.

He reappeared in a flashback in ''[[BW108|A Unova League Evolution!]]''.

|desc={{p|Joltik}} first appeared in ''[[BW039|Reunion Battles In Nimbasa!]]'', where it went up against [[Georgia's Beartic]]. Due to its small size, Joltik was very nimble and was able to outrun Beartic's attempts to hit it with {{m|Rock Smash}} before attaching itself to the {{pkmn|category|Freezing Pokémon}} and hitting it with a direct Thunderbolt. However, this move backfired as Beartic collapsed backwards onto Joltik, knocking it out.

Joltik's only known move is {{m|Thunderbolt}}.}}

Sylvester has at least two other Pokémon as those who entered the Club Battle were required to enter with three Pokémon.
